events.what: arXiv:2512.11469 compares ILP, PatternBoost and PPO on small grids (n<=19)

judgement.doubts: The bullet asks for the maximum as a function of all n (conjecturally below 2n for large n). Exhibiting 2n-point configurations for each n up to 76 determines the value for finitely many n; that is a census of instances (F4), not movement on the asymptotic question, which the record itself says 'remains open'. A reader who treats the known-n frontier as a bound could argue for progress; I do not, since no bound valid for all n moved. The AI-found solutions are for already-settled n and would be instances regardless.

corrections.why: F4: the record's own summary says the n=76 result is 'a lower-bound witness' for one more n while 'the general conjecture that 2n is not achievable for all large n remains open'; extending explicit 2n solutions from n=52 to n=76 checks finitely many instances of the question 'how many points ... in the n x n grid', and moves no bound valid for all n.
